meta.title: SP Tours | Custom Sri Lanka Travel Planning
meta.description: Plan a custom Sri Lanka tour with SP Tours — cultural triangle, hill country, wildlife safaris, and south coast beaches. Build your itinerary and chat with us on WhatsApp.

site.heroBody: SP Tours is a small team of Sri Lankan driver-guides who build one trip at a time. Sketch your route below — length, interests, pace — and watch a real day-by-day itinerary assemble itself. Then send it to us on WhatsApp and a human takes it from there.
site.whyBody: Every SP Tours trip is one car, one guide, one plan — yours. We live here, we drive these roads weekly, and we'd rather tell you to skip something than pad a schedule.
site.why1t: Planned by people who grew up on the route
site.why1b: Not a franchise desk. Our guides know which Sigiriya gate is empty at 6am and whose kitchen in Ella does the best kottu.
site.why2t: Your draft is the starting point, not our template
site.why2b: Build it here, send it over, and we edit with you — swap a day, add a cooking class, slow the whole thing down.
site.why3t: Same car, same driver, whole island
site.why3b: Air-conditioned, insured, honest about mountain roads. You stop where you want, for as long as you want.
site.why4b: Train strike, closed temple, sick stomach — message the same WhatsApp thread you booked in and it gets sorted.
site.whyCaption: Nuwara Eliya to Ella — 62 km, four tea stops, no schedule.
site.regH: A country you can cross in a morning — and never finish.
site.regBody: Pick the worlds that pull you. Each one drops straight into your draft itinerary below.
site.w1b: Rock fortresses, cave temples and a ruined capital you cycle through at dawn. Dry-zone heat, so we start early and end in a lake.
site.w2b: Cold mornings, tea gardens to the horizon, and the blue train that everyone photographs and nobody regrets. Bring a jumper — Nuwara Eliya hits 10°C.
site.w3b: Highest leopard density on earth, and we get you through the gate first. Udawalawe for elephants that don't read the guidebook.
site.w4b: Dutch ramparts, whale boats out at 6am, and the flat surf at Weligama that forgives beginners. This is where trips are meant to end.
site.w5b: Most people skip it. Give us a day and you'll get Pettah markets, Geoffrey Bawa's rooms, sunset on Galle Face and dinner worth the flight.
site.plH: Build the trip, then talk to us.
site.plBody: Four questions. The itinerary rewrites itself as you answer — nothing is locked, nothing is charged.
site.q1h: Under 7 days we'll keep you to two regions. Ten is the sweet spot.
site.q2h: Pick as many as you like — we'll weight the route toward them.
site.q3: How fast do you want to move?
site.q3h: Sri Lanka is small on a map and slow on the road. Be honest.
site.q4: When, and how many of you?
site.q4h: Optional — but it helps us check season, jeeps and rooms before we reply.
site.sendPlan: Send my plan to SP Tours on WhatsApp
site.sendNote: Opens WhatsApp with your draft already written out. No account, no deposit, no spam.
site.h1b: Four questions, a live day-by-day draft. Two minutes, no email gate.
site.h2b: One tap sends your draft to a real guide. We reply with a costed, refined version — usually within two hours.
site.h3b: Small deposit, driver's photo and number sent ahead, then the same thread stays open the whole trip.
site.tstH: What people say once they're home.
site.tst1: “We changed our minds twice mid-trip and Pradeep just rerouted us. It never felt like a tour.”
site.tst2: “Sigiriya at 6am with nobody on the stairs. That single piece of advice made the holiday.”
site.tst3: “They answered every question in our own language and planned the drives around our daughter's naps.”
site.ftH: Tell us where you want to wake up.
site.ftReply: Typical reply under 2 hours, 7 days a week.
site.ftLangs: We plan and guide in English, German, French, Russian and Chinese.

site.aboutLede: SP Tours is a working name for a team of Sri Lankan driver-guides who have spent years on these roads. We are not a call centre, and we do not resell someone else's coach tour.
site.aboutS1B: It began with one car and a phone number passed between guests. People kept asking for the same thing — someone local who answers honestly and plans around them rather than around a bus schedule. That is still the whole business.
site.aboutS2B: You draft the shape of the trip on this site, we refine it with you on WhatsApp, and one guide drives you the whole way. No handoffs between agents, no surprise upsells at the temple gate.
site.aboutS3B: We won't pack four regions into five days, we won't put you in an elephant-riding camp, and we won't send you to a place we haven't driven ourselves this year.
